أخترق (form VIII)
# أَخْتَرِقُ (ʔaḵtariqu) /ʔax.ta.ri.qu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِخْتَرَقَ (iḵtaraqa)
# أُخْتَرَقُ (ʔuḵtaraqu) /ʔux.ta.ra.qu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَرَقَ (iḵtaraqa)
# أَخْتَرِقَ (ʔaḵtariqa) /ʔax.ta.ri.qa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَرَقَ (iḵtaraqa)
# أُخْتَرَقَ (ʔuḵtaraqa) /ʔux.ta.ra
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
